{
  "candidate_rtl": "module alu_64bit(
    input [63:0] a, b,
    input [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [63:0] sum
);
    wire [63:0] x, y, p, g, bit_xor;
    wire [63:0] arith;
    wire [15:0] gp, gg;
    wire [15:0] p1, g1, g2;
    wire [15:0] block_c;
    wire cin;

    // Only 000, 001 and 010 select the arithmetic result.
    assign x = a ^ {64{Oper[1]}};
    assign y = b ^ {64{Oper[0]}};
    assign cin = Oper[0] | Oper[1];
    assign p = x | y;
    assign bit_xor = x ^ y;
    assign g[0] = (x[0] & y[0]) | (p[0] & cin);
    assign g[63:1] = x[63:1] & y[63:1];

    genvar k;
    generate
        for (k = 0; k < 16; k = k + 1) begin: groups
            assign gp[k] = &p[4*k +: 4];
            assign gg[k] = g[4*k+3]
                          | (p[4*k+3] & g[4*k+2])
                          | (p[4*k+3] & p[4*k+2] & g[4*k+1])
                          | (p[4*k+3] & p[4*k+2] & p[4*k+1] & g[4*k]);

            if (k == 0) begin: first
                assign p1[k] = gp[k];
                assign g1[k] = gg[k];
            end else if (k == 1) begin: second
                assign p1[k] = gp[k] & gp[k-1];
                assign g1[k] = gg[k] | (gp[k] & gg[k-1]);
            end else if (k == 2) begin: third
                assign p1[k] = gp[k] & gp[k-1] & gp[k-2];
                assign g1[k] = gg[k]
                             | (gp[k] & gg[k-1])
                             | (gp[k] & gp[k-1] & gg[k-2]);
            end else begin: remaining
                assign p1[k] = gp[k] & gp[k-1] & gp[k-2] & gp[k-3];
                assign g1[k] = gg[k]
                             | (gp[k] & gg[k-1])
                             | (gp[k] & gp[k-1] & gg[k-2])
                             | (gp[k] & gp[k-1] & gp[k-2] & gg[k-3]);
            end

            if (k < 4) begin: prefix_a
                assign g2[k] = g1[k];
            end else if (k < 8) begin: prefix_b
                assign g2[k] = g1[k] | (p1[k] & g1[k-4]);
            end else if (k < 12) begin: prefix_c
                assign g2[k] = g1[k]
                             | (p1[k] & g1[k-4])
                             | (p1[k] & p1[k-4] & g1[k-8]);
            end else begin: prefix_d
                assign g2[k] = g1[k]
                             | (p1[k] & g1[k-4])
                             | (p1[k] & p1[k-4] & g1[k-8])
                             | (p1[k] & p1[k-4] & p1[k-8] & g1[k-12]);
            end

            if (k == 0) begin: initial_carry
                assign block_c[k] = 1'b0;
                assign arith[4*k] = bit_xor[4*k] ^ cin;
            end else begin: other_carry
                assign block_c[k] = g2[k-1];
                assign arith[4*k] = bit_xor[4*k] ^ block_c[k];
            end
            assign arith[4*k+1] = bit_xor[4*k+1]
                ^ (g[4*k] | (p[4*k] & block_c[k]));
            assign arith[4*k+2] = bit_xor[4*k+2]
                ^ (g[4*k+1]
                   | (p[4*k+1] & g[4*k])
                   | (p[4*k+1] & p[4*k] & block_c[k]));
            assign arith[4*k+3] = bit_xor[4*k+3]
                ^ (g[4*k+2]
                   | (p[4*k+2] & g[4*k+1])
                   | (p[4*k+2] & p[4*k+1] & g[4*k])
                   | (p[4*k+2] & p[4*k+1] & p[4*k] & block_c[k]));
        end
    endgenerate

    always @(*) begin
        case (Oper)
            3'b000, 3'b001, 3'b010: sum = arith;
            3'b011: sum = a | b;
            3'b100: sum = a & b;
            3'b101: sum = a ^ b;
            3'b110: sum = a ~^ b;
            default: sum = 64'b0;
        endcase
    end
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline critical paths run from low operand bits to high result bits through arithmetic carry logic and final operation selection. Separate arithmetic expressions also increase mapped logic and input loading.",
  "rewrite": "Share one configurable adder across addition and both subtraction directions. Use OR-propagate carry equations, four-bit local lookahead, and a two-stage radix-four prefix over sixteen groups. Fold the initial carry into bit-zero generation, avoiding a separate carry-in distribution stage across the prefix network.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The explicitly bounded carry network is intended to reduce maximum arrival relative to the 3.05 ns baseline. A numerical improvement is not verified; the specified synthesis, buffering and STA flow must determine actual arrival and electrical compliance.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Sharing the arithmetic datapath should provide area headroom for the parallel prefix logic. The prefix introduces additional group terms and routing fanout. Mapped area, the 13098.437440 um2 cap, and zero max-slew/max-capacitance violations require validation in the specified flow.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module interface and unsigned 64-bit outputs for every binary input. Arithmetic is modulo 2^64: 000 computes a+b, 001 computes a+~b+1, and 010 computes ~a+b+1. Logical operations and the zero default for 111 remain unchanged. The original internal c_out is unobservable and is omitted. No state, latency, assumptions, external dependencies or undefined outputs are introduced."
}
